context_snapshot.description: Refresh compact TradingAgents context only. Does not call broker submit paths.

pre_open_context_refresh.description: Refresh external MiroFish handoff status first, then compact TradingAgents context for pre-open dashboards. Analysis-only and cannot submit orders.

daily_report_preview.description: Render the current daily supervisor report for dashboard/notification preview only. Does not send email or submit orders.

overnight_plan_compact_preview.description: Refresh source-quality flags, then build a bounded compact overnight dashboard preview without writing latest pointers, appending ledger forecasts, running full graph models, or submitting orders.

premarket_brief_compact_preview.description: Build a compact rolling premarket dashboard preview from local packets without updating latest pointers or submitting orders.

preopen_validation_preview.description: Read fresh Alpaca/context state into an analysis-only pre-open validation packet for dashboards. Does not submit orders or refresh live-control.

hourly_supervisor_dry_run_preview.description: Run the hourly supervisor against live account/market data in dry-run compact preview mode under an n8n-only log directory. Does not submit orders.

n8n_evaluation_dataset.description: Write a Data Table-ready n8n built-in evaluation dataset covering all allowlisted automation wrappers and edge cases. Analysis-only and cannot submit orders.

overnight_calibration_guard.description: Build the analysis-only walk-forward calibration guard for overnight strategy influence. Cannot submit orders or promote sleeves.

research_automation_orchestration_plan.description: Run the analysis-only model/source orchestration health plan for dashboards, including local helper route health. Cannot submit orders or promote sleeves.

compact_output_audit.description: Measure compact-output byte reductions for high-traffic automation packets. Analysis-only and cannot submit orders.

process_review.description: Run the Plugin Eval-style repo process review. Analysis-only and cannot submit orders.

automation_health_audit.description: Audit TradingAgents automation schedule evidence and run artifacts. Analysis-only and cannot submit orders.

execution_board_review.description: Run the BOARD execution review after hourly activity. Analysis-only and cannot submit orders.

outcome_labeling.description: Apply resolved Agent Intelligence outcome labels to advisory model and market-mirror reports. Analysis-only and cannot submit orders.

mirofish_handoff_status.description: Check whether the external MiroFish run has a final TradingAgents handoff yet. Analysis-only and cannot submit orders.

source_quality_review.description: Review research source freshness/quality for dashboard flags. Analysis-only and cannot submit orders.

loss_review_evidence.description: Build the analysis-only evidence packet for the latest hourly loss-review decision so BOARD can review losers without giving n8n submit authority.

self_heal_handoff.description: Build a safe Codex self-heal handoff when compact context shows supervisor or control-plane errors. Analysis-only and cannot submit orders.

self_heal_plan.description: Classify compact failure signals into audited safe-plane self-heal plans or escalations. Analysis-only and cannot submit orders.

self_heal_execute_safe.description: Run only allowlisted safe-plane self-heal refresh/verification actions, then write the audited plan. Analysis-only and cannot submit orders.

creator_workflow_status.description: Summarize preserved original TradingAgents workflow role artifacts. Analysis-only and cannot submit orders.

agent_ledger_summary.description: Summarize Agent Intelligence Ledger influence weights. Analysis-only and cannot submit orders.

agent_ledger_update.description: Append latest overnight/MiroFish advisory forecasts, resolve due Agent Intelligence Ledger rows, and write the summary. Analysis-only and cannot submit orders.
